hero_tagline: Full-stack development for websites, apps, and backends that work in practice.
benefits_label: Websites, apps, backends, integrations, and automation without unnecessary platform lock-in.
benefits_heading: Bring me an idea, messy system, or clear brief. I will help you turn it into software that is useful, maintainable, and ready to grow.
service_webapp_desc: Custom portals, dashboards, client zones, and business tools with frontend, backend, database, and deployment handled together.
service_backend_desc: APIs, databases, CRM, HubSpot, payment, and internal system integrations built on proven frameworks, so another developer can take over later.
service_automation_desc: Replace repeated manual work with practical tools, workflows, imports, exports, and admin screens your team can actually use.
service_frontend_desc: Fast websites, landing pages, and CMS-backed pages tailored to your business instead of forcing you into a boxed template.
service_mobile_desc: Mobile and desktop apps connected to your backend, data, and business workflow when a website alone is not enough.
service_strategy_desc: Need a second pair of eyes before you commit? I can review the idea, call out risks, and suggest a sane technical direction.
service_hardware_desc: Lightweight advice on hardware, technical setup, and practical IT decisions when it supports the software you need.
work_subtitle: Specific case studies are often limited by NDAs, so this page shows the types of work I primarily specialize in.
work_example_webapp_desc: Portals, dashboards, admin systems, booking flows, and customer-facing tools built around your actual process.
work_example_integrations_desc: Connect CRMs, HubSpot, payments, APIs, databases, and internal systems without creating a fragile black box.
work_example_automation_desc: Turn repeated manual steps into tools, imports, exports, scheduled jobs, and workflows that save attention.
work_example_websites_desc: Simple sites, landing pages, and company websites with a maintainable CMS setup instead of unnecessary template bloat.
work_example_mobile_desc: Apps connected to your backend and data, built when mobile or desktop experience matters to the product.
work_example_consulting_desc: Architecture checks, stack choices, code reviews, and honest feedback before a technical decision gets expensive.
work_clients_desc: Forecom Solutions, eSoul, Eywo, Cymedica, Safetica, and BOS Automotive.
about_hero_subtitle: From a simple website to a full-stack app, backend integration, or internal tool, I focus on clear communication, strict code standards, and software another developer can maintain later.
about_who_heading: A full-stack developer who prefers straight answers and useful software.
about_bio_1: I am a self-taught full-stack developer with 6 years of experience and 32 shipped projects. I work across websites, web apps, iOS and macOS apps, backend integrations, automation, and technical consulting.
about_bio_2: I use frameworks people know, document decisions, and avoid unnecessary lock-in. If a boxed solution is enough, I will say it. If it will become a problem later, I will say that too.
about_bio_3: Clients usually value my direct communication as much as the code itself. The goal is simple: understand the problem, build the right thing, and keep the work moving without agency theater.
about_philosophy_subtitle: Direct communication, practical technical choices, and clean delivery without unnecessary ceremony.
about_value_clean_desc: I care about code quality because the project has to survive handover, growth, and future changes.
about_value_user_desc: I do not push boxed solutions or extra work when they do not fit the problem.
about_value_perf_desc: AI is part of my day-to-day workflow, but I still review, test, and own what ships.
about_tech_subtitle: Recognizable, maintainable technologies for websites, apps, backends, integrations, and CMS work.
services_subtitle: From websites and landing pages to web apps, iOS apps, integrations, automation, and technical decisions, I help you choose and build what makes sense.
process_subtitle: Clear enough for a small website. Structured enough for a serious application.
process_step_1_desc: You can bring a clear brief or just a rough idea. We clarify the goal, constraints, users, and what would make the work successful.
process_step_2_desc: I suggest the stack, scope, and first steps. If a simpler solution is enough, I will not push something bigger.
process_step_3_desc: I build in focused milestones, use AI where it helps, and keep standards high through review, tests, and regular updates.
process_step_4_desc: I help get the work live, hand over the important context, and can stay available for support or future improvements.
contact_subtitle: Send a few lines about your website, app, integration, or system problem. We can sort out scope, next steps, and whether I am the right fit.
contact_info_subtitle: Email or call me directly. If you prefer a short first message, that is enough to start.

privacy_intro: Your privacy is important. This policy outlines how personal information is collected, used, and protected when you visit this website.
privacy_section_1_text: We collect minimal information necessary to provide you with the best experience. This may include:
privacy_section_1_item_1: Contact information you voluntarily provide (name, email, phone) via forms.
privacy_section_1_item_2: Anonymous usage data to help us improve website performance.
privacy_section_1_item_3: Device and browser information for optimization purposes.
privacy_section_2_text: Any information collected is used solely for the purpose of communicating with you regarding projects, inquiries, or services. We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personally identifiable information to outside parties.
privacy_section_3_text: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy_section_4_text: This website may contain links to third-party sites. These third-party sites have separate and independent privacy policies. We therefore have no responsibility or liability for the content and activities of these linked sites.
privacy_section_5_text: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, you may contact us using the information on our Contact page.
